question:
**Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

__Incidently__, I happened to bump into my childhood friend at the airport yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Incidentally**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options '**Incidentally**' is correctly spelt word.
 
• It is 'used to introduce extra news, information, etc. that the speaker has just thought of'. [वक्ता को तुरंत सूझी बात (कोई ख़बर, जानकारी आदि) को प्रस्‍तुत करने के लिए प्रयुक्त शब्‍द; प्रसंगतः, प्रसंगवश]
 
 
• *Example: **Incidentally**, that new restaurant you told me about is excellent.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Incidentally.*
